title: ApplicationManifest
description: Schema v4 — app manifest for an OpenClaw bot application registered with Evolve.

id.description: Slug identifier. Used as the filename. Lowercase, hyphens only.

bot_id.description: The bot account that owns this app, e.g. 'admin_bot'.

description.description: One-paragraph description of what this app does.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Set automatically by Evolve.

app_version.description: Semver of the app itself, e.g. '0.1.0'.

owner.description: Bot account that owns/runs this app.

maintainers.description: Human operators responsible for this app.

confidence.description: Discovery confidence score (0.0–1.0). Set by scanner.

last_reviewed.description: ISO date of last human review, e.g. '2026-04-11'.

updated_at.description: ISO datetime updated on any change.

identity.description: What is this application and why does it exist?

success_criteria.description: How do we know this app is working?

observable_outcomes.description: Specific, verifiable behaviors you can observe.

failure_signals.description: Specific indicators that something is broken.

quality_bar.description: What minimum acceptable looks like vs excellent.

files.description: Scripts, code files, and assets belonging to this app (relative to workspace root).

crons.description: Cron entries belonging to this app (crontab format).

exported_hooks.description: Named functions/entry points other apps or bots can call.

docs.description: Paths to documentation files (relative to workspace root).

test_command.description: Shell command to run the app's test suite from the workspace root as the bot user.

last_result.description: Behavioural-run result. error means trigger or judge call itself failed (separated from fail for telemetry). See internal/spec-behavioral-runs-2026-05-07.md §2.

last_notes.description: One- or two-sentence judge explanation for the most recent run. Empty string when not yet judged.

last_judge_model.description: Resolved model id (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) used for the most recent judge call. Empty string when the case has not run.

last_judge_tokens.description: Combined input + output tokens for the most recent judge call. Powers the daily cost rollup.

last_tested.description: ISO datetime of last test run.

last_test_run.description: ISO datetime of last test_command execution.

last_test_output.description: Truncated stdout/stderr from last test_command run.

last_test_exit_code.description: Exit code from last test_command run.

test_cadence.description: Per-app override of pod-wide app_testing.default_cadence in network.json. null means inherit pod default. See internal/spec-app-testing-2026-05-07.md §3.

test_exemption_reason.description: When set, forge enforcement accepts a manifest without test_command/test_cases. Operator-supplied reason; surfaced as audit trail on the Applications card. Empty string means tests are required.

rsigrade_signals.description: Named operational metrics tracked during normal operation. Labels for the RSI loop.

evidence_files.description: Files used to discover this app (set by scanner).

compliance_suppressed.description: If true, this app is intentionally exempt from unregistered-asset flagging.

compliance_suppressed_reason.description: Why this app is suppressed from compliance checks.

version.description: Legacy integer manifest version. Use app_version for semver.

priority.description: Deprecated. All apps are equally optional.
